function.arguments: {"status": "success", "summary": "修改文件：app.ini（工作区根目录，唯一改动）。方式：用 edit_file 做最小化的定向替换，old_string 带上下文 `[staging]\\nhost = staging.internal\\nretries = 3` → 只把该段 retries 改为 5，并带原始 sha256 校验防止并发改动。验证：读取改动后全文（cat -A 确认无隐藏字符/额外行），并用 awk 按 `[section]` 归属提取每个 retries 项，结果显示 [dev] retries = 3、[staging] retries = 5、[prod] retries = 3；文件行数与结构未变（仅第 7 行 3→5），其它段落同名项保持原样。", "evidence": ["app.ini (workspace root), sha256 before edit bb42c189c579375f7250a8c8c73f3cbbea83ff589f1bbc58339b96e9e7f02993", "edit_file diff: only '-retries = 3' '+retries = 5' under [staging]", "awk '/^\\[/{s=$0} /^retries/{print s, $0}' app.ini -> '[dev] retries = 3', '[staging] retries = 5', '[prod] retries = 3'", "cat -A app.ini shows 12 lines, no trailing/whitespace anomalies"]}
